ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a ratio of approximately 98:2 against high-intensity white punctate markers.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigment across both lobes. Discrete white circular blobs are spatially mapped primarily to the distal tips and the trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an acute angle; notch depth represents approximately 15% of the visible vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated margin with irregular, high-frequency peaks and valleys. Pronounced jaggedness and increased pixel-amplitude at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-curving convex trajectory from the medial notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; sparse individual white spots across the central surface area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, near-parallel, light-colored linear marks (rake marks) oriented horizontally on the mid-section of the left lobe (viewer's left).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Linear rake marks on the left lobe and significant barnacle encrustations on the trailing edge and distal margins.
